name: BaaLiss Grass Farm
tagline: BaaLiss Grass Farm — Beef in Fredericktown, OH
description: BaaLiss Grass Farm is an on-farm market in 7285 County Road 183, OH, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
